passiveBonuses.desc: Nearby castles and towers empower each other, increasing firing speed by 20% and triggering a rallying call that briefly buffs nearby infantry attack speed when a tower or keep is attacked
Villagers build 15% faster than other civilizations
Farms provide +75 food yield before depleting, rewarding long-term economic investment
Longbowmen have +1 range compared to standard archers and can build Archery Ranges in the field

age2.bonus: Villagers and infantry can garrison inside for rapid healing (30 HP/s). Emits a +2 attack aura to all nearby military units within 10 tiles
Town Center gains +25% HP, +2 attack, and can train all Age 2 military units 25% faster. Acts as a secondary defensive anchor early game

age3.bonus: Generates 1 gold per second passively. Allows recruitment of the King hero unit who inspires nearby troops with +15% attack and defense aura
All towers and keeps gain +5 range and +10% attack speed. All tower weapon upgrades (Springald, Cannon) are researched for free

age4.bonus: Longbowmen train in pairs for the cost of 1.5x a single unit. All ranged units gain +2 range. Enables the Wynguard Army formation ability
Produces a free Wynguard Ranger and Wynguard Footman pack every 3 minutes automatically. Wynguard units have +20% HP and attack compared to standard equivalents

uniqueUnits.special: Has 1 extra range compared to standard archers. Can construct Archery Ranges in the field. Volley ability fires a burst of arrows in a targeted area dealing area damage
Available one age earlier than equivalent heavy infantry for other civilizations. High armor value makes them exceptionally resilient against arrow fire
Elite longbowman variant exclusive to English Age 4. Deals bonus damage to cavalry and can apply a slowing poison on hit

uniqueTech.effect: Farms generate +1 food per minute passively without needing a villager assigned, simulating the English enclosure movement
Doubles the empowerment radius of the Network of Castles passive bonus. Castles now also grant nearby units a +5% damage resistance aura
Longbowmen gain the ability to set up camp, increasing attack speed by 15% while stationary. Activates automatically after standing still for 3 seconds
